title: Law to require sidewalk-detection brakes on shared e-bikes/scooters
summary: This bill would require companies operating electric bike and scooter share systems to install sidewalk riding detection technology on their devices. It would also require a safety feature that automatically and gradually slows a device to a stop if it detects the device riding on a sidewalk. A first violation carries no penalty, but repeat violations within two years could bring a civil penalty of up to $1,000.
